items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 21 at 1:40PM EDT until October 22 at 5:00AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 5 to 7 feet. North to northeast winds 15 knots and
gusty.

* WHERE...Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM EDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 21 at 1:40PM EDT until October 23 at 4:00AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 6 to 8 feet. North to northeast winds 15 to 20 knots
and gusty.

* WHERE...Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm, Flagler
Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 20-60 nm, Volusia-Brevard
County Line to Sebastian Inlet 20-60 nm and Sebastian Inlet to
Jupiter Inlet 20-60 nm.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
